label: Mechanism–aetiology matching
description: Relating a drug’s mechanism of action to the biological aetiology of a patient’s condition.

label: Biomarkers & stratification
description: Identifying biological and clinical characteristics that distinguish treatment-relevant patient groups.

description: Investigating genetic influences on drug exposure, benefit and adverse effects.
